entity_raw.definition_raw:
You’ve fought enough specters that doing so has become second nature.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 7th, duskwalker, ghost hunter racial trait.

Benefit(s): You can use your ghost hunter ability to grant your weapons the ghost touch special ability as a swift action. You can activate ghost hunter an additional time each day.
